title: Backrooms N' Things
description: This mod tries its hardest to add things related to the backrooms to Minecraft!
body:
Backrooms

Bring the unsettling atmosphere of the Backrooms into Minecraft.

This mod adds a variety of objects, entities, decorations, and items inspired by the Backrooms, allowing players to create strange liminal spaces, abandoned hallways, eerie office rooms, and other familiar environments from Backrooms stories and media.

Features
Backrooms-inspired blocks and decorations
Fluorescent lighting and office-themed props
Furniture and miscellaneous objects commonly associated with liminal spaces
Great for building maps, roleplay worlds, and exploration experiences
Designed to fit naturally within Minecraft while capturing the unsettling feeling of the Backrooms

Whether you're recreating iconic levels, designing your own endless maze, or simply adding a touch of liminal horror to your world, this mod provides the tools to make your builds feel strangely familiar.

This mod is inspired by the Backrooms concept created and expanded by the online community and is not affiliated with any official Backrooms creators.

PS, We do recommend you play with the Char1ie's Backrooms resource pack.
